Tradicijska Kumpanija, UNESCO-ova nematerijalna kulturna baština.

Čara is one of the five villages on Korčula Island that preserves the Kumpanija sword dance, a chain sword dance of great antiquity performed in summer and listed as UNESCO intangible cultural heritage.

the grape harvest in Carsko Polje in September and early October is one of the most visually striking seasonal events on the island, with the whole field in activity. Wine production at the cooperative cellar follows immediately after.
Čara je jedno od pet sela na Korčuli koje čuva Kumpaniju, tradicionalni mađarski borbeni ples, koji se izvodi u ljeto.

candidate.hr: Sail Away Korčula - tour with traditional craftmanship boat
candidate.en: Sail Away Korčula - tour with traditional craftmanship boat

desc.hr: Join us on a boat trip around Korčula archipelago islands. Enjoy swiming and snorkeling in crystal clear sea. Refresh yourselves with carefully prepared snacks and cold drinks. Welcome aboard!

A 4-hour panoramic tour through Korčula's wine country aboard an open-top cabrio mini bus, visiting 3 family-owned wineries and tasting 10 local wines including Pošip and Grk — grape varieties unique to the island. Honey, olive oil, and liqueur tastings included.

Unforgettable Adriatic evenings - Private sunset cruise for up to 10 guests. Calm seas, golden horizons, and the whisper of wind in the sails – the perfect way to make unforgettable memories..on the deck of our traditional wooden boat, built in 1941.

candidate.hr: Korčula: Vintage / Electric Car Tour with Wine and Olive Oil Tasting
candidate.en: Korčula: Vintage / Electric Car Tour with Wine and Olive Oil Tasting

desc.hr: Explore Korčula in a vintage car, taste local wines and olive oils, and discover the island's rich history and scenic beauty on this guided tour.

Embark on an unforgettable journey through Korčula’s Old Town with an expert guide, exploring its rich history and Marco Polo heritage. Enjoy panoramic views, local farm tastings, and a scenic vineyard drive, ending with a wine tasting paired with authentic island delicacies.
The tour includes a guided city tour with a visitor to the observation deck and a tasting of homemade products from the family farm OPG Anica Bažika.
